nea26fee48d.headline: The fight between companies to deliver supermarket purchases in 10 minutes intensifies
nea26fee48d.summary: Four startups in Spain are competing to lead the rapidly growing sector of delivering supermarket purchases within 10 minutes, attracting million-dollar investments.
nea26fee48d.why: Rapid grocery delivery is an emerging business model with potential to disrupt retail and logistics sectors, attracting significant investment.
